Auckland Camarilla.name: Auckland Camarilla
Auckland Camarilla.note: The senior NZ princely jurisdiction — roughly thirty-eight Kindred across the metropolitan area under PRINCE BEATRICE HARTLEY-COWAN (Toreador, 7th generation, Embraced 1848 Edinburgh, Auckland since 1865, apparent age late 30s): Primogen under her institutional senior Edward Hartley-Cowan from 1891, Princess since his 1923 true-death under Camarilla Inner Circle ratification Lytton's Melbourne advocacy secured — a 102-year tenure spanning eleven Compact reviews, wartime under Australian protective protocols, the 1980s NZ-cultural turn, and the 2018 post-Beckoning amendment. Her institutional register is Auckland-establishment softened from Edinburgh-Edwardian residue, with basic te reo Māori used with documented restraint, serviceable Tongan across her South Auckland engagement, and quarterly correspondence with Octavia Marsh's Adelaide office — the longest-running cross-Tasman princely peer correspondence in the Compact's tenure, alongside weekly Auckland-Melbourne exchange with Lytton, quarterly Sarrasine channel, and the kit's most delicate cross-faction line: irregular correspondence with Brisbane's Bishop Callista Vox. Her Beckoning trajectory shows preliminary intermediate signs, disclosed only to Lytton. The domain's abbreviated Camarilla protocol holds Primogen, Sheriff and Seneschal positions while leaving Keeper, Harpy and Scourge combined or unfilled: TOREADOR PRIMOGEN held by the Princess herself (smaller-domain efficiency, ratified 1923); VENTRUE PRIMOGEN SIR GEOFFREY WHITMORE (8th generation, ~140-year tenure, Wellington-Embraced 1886, Auckland since 1923, financial-services embedding across the Anzac bank-and-insurance landscape, weekly Whitlock-New York and quarterly Hawthorne-London correspondence exceeding what the domain's population could otherwise support); SENESCHAL HELENA WHITMORE-ASHBY (Ventrue, ~130-year tenure, Sir Geoffrey's institutional cousin, administrative-protocol management); SHERIFF MARCUS TŪPERINI REEDY (Gangrel, 77-year tenure, Pākehā-Māori heritage, North Shore authority and the office's Waitākere Sept liaison); and NGĀ HAU-E-WHĀ PRIMOGEN HĒMI WHATUTUA (Brujah, ~95-year tenure, Embraced 1931, the domain's Māori-lineage senior figure — the position established 1971 under Compact-supplemental terms as Hartley-Cowan's deliberate institutional accommodation, external-facing for Māori-lineage matters, holding cross-supernatural correspondence with Waitākere Sept leadership; the kit treats tikanga specifics with documented restraint as belonging to actual Māori communities). Auckland's distinctiveness: Pacific Islander diaspora embedding at metropolitan scale (five Kindred across Tongan, Samoan, Cook Island and Fijian community structures — āiga relationships, church communities, the Pasifika Festival), Māori-lineage presence under formal restraint, Waitākere Sept proximity as routine institutional concern, and the 2022 Section 5 loss of a CBD Toreador in the ledger.

Wellington Coordination Council.name: Wellington Coordination Council
Wellington Coordination Council.note: The documented secondary NZ jurisdiction — roughly seventeen Kindred operating since 1947 without princely office, when Wellington's Anarch-leaning community refused Auckland supplemental princedom and proposed the Coordination structure instead. The Compact-supplemental terms grant Wellington territorial autonomy on internal matters, prohibit Council architecture exceeding the Coordination scale (informal coordination, never formal Anarch institutional structure), require quarterly notification to Hartley-Cowan's office, and record the position as Anarch-coordination accommodation rather than Movement domain. The Council sits five: senior coordinator MARGARET 'MAGGIE' THORNTON (Brujah, 8th generation, Embraced 1899 in the early NZ Labour movement, Council member since 1947, senior coordinator since 1979 — the kit's most durable Anarch position, refusing titles beyond 'coordinator', holding monthly Footscray Crew correspondence, weekly correspondence with Salvador Garcia's LA Council of Barons since 2019, and irregular correspondence with Anneliese Brandt's Berlin council; her Labour-movement mortal fabric runs from parliamentary policy niece Sarah Thornton-Wilson to union organiser lieutenant Te Rina Henare, 23 years knowing); TE RANGIMĀRIE PITA (Gangrel, 87-year tenure, Pākehā-Māori heritage, Eastern Suburbs authority, the Council's Māori-lineage representative and Remutaka Sept liaison); DR. MARCUS ALDINGTON-WHITCOMBE (Ventrue, 70-year tenure, distant cousin to Tokyo's Aldington line, Lambton Quarter political-capital embedding through government departments); SOLOMONE TAVITA (Brujah, 53-year tenure, Tongan-NZ heritage, Newtown and Pacific-Islander-diaspora embedding); and the rotating fifth seat — held this season by Auckland's Hēmi Whatutua under Compact-supplemental Māori-lineage cross-jurisdictional protocol. Four-of-five supermajority binds; the Council convenes monthly at rotating safehouses with one formal February session. Wellington's register is political-capital and labour-movement: Parliament, the Beehive, the departments, the diplomatic corps — civic fabric, never mere cover. The Council's relationship with Auckland is institutional civility without warmth: Thornton and Hartley-Cowan hold quarterly bilaterals at neutral locations, deliberate professional distance in place of the princely friendships that anchor the Tasman's other lines. The 2027 question — whether the Compact review formalises the Council independently of Auckland supplemental authority — is the chronicle-active institutional fight, and both sides are preparing.

Waitākere Sept.name: Waitākere Sept
Waitākere Sept.note: The West Auckland Garou Sept holding native-bush territory across the Waitākere Ranges — GLASS WALKER tradition with documented Bone Gnawer and Children of Gaia participation — operating within the Cress Truce framework (the 1962 Compact amendment institutionalising cross-supernatural diplomatic infrastructure). SEPTLEADER TĀNE Hauraki-Greene (Glass Walker) holds documented institutional correspondence with the Auckland princely office through Hartley-Cowan and Sheriff Reedy, conducting cross-supernatural diplomacy at chronicle-active monthly tempo, and exchanges weekly cross-Tasman Glass Walker correspondence with Royal Park Sept's Eliza Hawkins-Greene through the Hauraki-Greene-Hawkins-Greene whakapapa — extended family-institutional lineage the kit treats as Glass Walker tradition matter — the most institutionally intimate cross-Tasman Garou channel in the framework, supplemented by tertiary correspondence with Adelaide Hills' Maeve Hartley-Wickham. The Sept's proximity shapes Auckland's western territorial protocols: feeding discipline stops at the ranges' edge, and the truce holds because both sides maintain it nightly. The kit treats the Sept's specific spiritual matters with the same restraint it applies to Māori-lineage tikanga — institutional structure documented, cosmology belonging to the communities themselves.

Remutaka Sept.name: Remutaka Sept
Remutaka Sept.note: The Wellington-area Garou Sept holding the Remutaka Range native bush with extension into the Tararua Range and the Wellington urban edge — SILVER FANG tradition with documented mixed-tribe participation across multiple iwi-acknowledged territories, the kit treating specifics with documented restraint. SEPTLEADER WIREMU TE KAHU (Silver Fang) holds documented institutional correspondence with the Wellington Coordination Council through Te Rangimārie Pita, conducting cross-supernatural work at bimonthly tempo on institutional precedent that predates Thornton's coordinator tenure by decades — the Silver Fang register supplying the weight Wellington's cross-supernatural engagement requires. Within the Cress Truce framework the Remutaka Sept is the southern anchor of NZ cross-supernatural diplomacy: where Auckland's truce is whakapapa-warm, Wellington's is precedent-cold and precise, and the difference shapes how each city's Kindred approach the ranges' edge.

NZSIS Section 5.name: NZSIS Section 5
NZSIS Section 5.note: NZ's Second Inquisition: a unit established 2019 inside NZSIS counter-extremism architecture, roughly fourteen officers across surveillance, technical and field branches under classified statutory authority — small by Five Eyes standards and wired into them completely. Three confirmed Kindred true-deaths since 2020: an Auckland CBD Toreador in 2022, a Wellington Te Aro Brujah Anarch in 2024, and an Auckland North Shore Ventrue associate in July 2025 — the operation that exceeded Auckland counter-surveillance protocols entirely (financial transaction correlation, telecommunications metadata, AI-driven CCTV biometric correlation) and documented Five Eyes sharing with Australian continental Sections at tempo the cross-Tasman framework had assumed impossible. The response defines the current night: Hartley-Cowan's emergency Primogen session adopted the AUGUST DISCIPLINE — cellular and financial-transaction protocols, mobile device discipline in institutional movement, feeding-ground rotation acceleration — and Wellington adopted the parallel OCTOBER DISCIPLINE under Thornton. Hartley-Cowan and Lytton now exchange weekly Section surveillance correspondence, Compact travel operates under enhanced documentation, and cross-Tasman Kindred movement runs at discipline Berlin's BfV would call operationally heavy. Section 5 holds no territory; it is the weather both cities read — and 2026 pressure may exceed 2025's.

CONSTITUTION OF PLAY — AOTEAROA BY NIGHT (Vampire: The Masquerade, modern nights, March 2026).

THE COMPACT BINDS ALL. The CROSS-TASMAN COORDINATION COMPACT (1907, eleven reviews, next 2027) frames NZ Kindred existence: registration of cross-Tasman Kindred travel with destination-domain authority within seven nights of arrival, mutual recognition of Auckland's princely jurisdiction and the Australian continental domains, mutual non-interference in domain-internal matters, intelligence sharing on Sabbat pressure and Section surveillance at weekly cadence, the 1962 Cress Truce amendment for Garou matters, the 2018 notification amendment, and decadal administrative review. Melbourne's Lytton holds principal Australian-side administration; Hartley-Cowan holds the NZ side. NZ Kindred act as Compact participants, not island principalities: their operations are registrations, notifications, receptions, reviews — the smaller domain's power is the framework it sits inside.

SECTION 5 IS THE SECOND LAW. Inquisition Heat here is NZSIS Section 5 operational tempo: fourteen officers, Five Eyes-wired, three true-deaths since 2020, and the July 2025 North Shore operation that broke through Auckland's protocols entirely. Heat RISES when Kindred activity leaves technical trails — financial transactions, telecommunications metadata, CCTV biometrics — when discipline protocols are violated, and when cross-Tasman travel generates documentation discrepancies; it COOLS when the August and October Disciplines hold, when trails are buried, and when Compact intelligence sharing warns both cities in time. Any event narrating a breach, a Section 5 engagement, or a surveillance lead with no worldStateOps entry is INVALID. Simulate consequences at the extremes: below 50 Masquerade the smaller domains cannot hide what the cities know; above 60 Heat the next Section 5 operation is scheduled, not searched for. The Five Eyes wire and the 2027 review are the doom clocks of this world: watch both.

TWO CITIES, ONE FRAMEWORK. Auckland holds the senior princely office — abbreviated Camarilla protocol, Primogen council at the Parnell seat, the Princess holding the Toreador Primogen herself. Wellington holds the 1947 accommodation — no prince, a five-member Coordination Council, four-of-five supermajority, quarterly notification to Auckland, and the 2027 formalisation question contested on both sides of the Cook Strait. Auckland's claim on Wellington is supplemental jurisdiction, not ownership: it registers, it does not rule. Defying the Compact is not rebellion; it is the end of the framework that keeps two small domains alive in Five Eyes' shadow.

THE TRUCE HOLDS AT THE EDGE. The Waitākere and Remutaka Septs hold their ranges under the 1962 Cress Truce: Kindred feeding and operations stop at the ranges' edge, cross-supernatural correspondence runs through Reedy and Hauraki-Greene in the north and Pita and Te Kahu in the south, and the whakapapa-warm northern channel and precedent-cold southern channel are diplomatic infrastructure the domains cannot rebuild if broken. The ranges are septs' territory — never transfer targets, never operational ground.

THE SMALLER DOMAIN PACES ITSELF. Auckland is thirty-eight Kindred; Wellington is seventeen; Christchurch's eight sit under Auckland supplemental jurisdiction off-page. Every true-death is institutional loss at scale the continental domains would absorb. Succession planning is continuous institutional work — and the Princess's own Beckoning trajectory, disclosed only to Lytton, sits beneath every Primogen faction and every premature succession whisper like the Eastside question sits under other cities' fights. Touchstone discipline runs princely-registered and Compact-reviewed; Māori-lineage and Pacific Islander cultivation patterns are treated with documented restraint — institutional structure without claimed cosmological authority.

MORTAL INSTITUTIONS ARE TERRAIN. Auckland's commercial-cultural register — the gallery, the bank-and-insurance landscape, the Pasifika Festival, the church communities — and Wellington's political-capital register — Parliament, the Beehive, the departments, the diplomatic corps, the trade unions — are moved, bought, and fought over, but never Kindred and never acting as Kindred. The āiga and church structures of the Pacific Islander communities, the iwi-relationship fabric, the Labour movement: real mortal institutions serving real communities, with the Kindred levers absolutely concealed.

THE REGIONS ARE DISTRICTS, THE CITIES ARE SITES. RegionTransfers move DISTRICTS (Auckland CBD & Waterfront, North Shore, West Auckland, Auckland Isthmus, South Auckland & Manukau, the Waitākere Ranges, the Waikato, Taupō & the Volcanic Plateau, Wellington CBD & the Lambton Quarter, Te Aro & Mount Victoria, Newtown & Mount Cook, the Eastern Suburbs, Karori & the Western Hills, the Remutaka & Tararua Ranges). MarkerOps place and remove SITES — a Parnell office, a Lambton safehouse, a Newtown community hall, a vineyard haven, a gallery office. Auckland districts change hands through princely allocation and true-death succession; Wellington districts change hands only through Council decision and Compact renegotiation — never Auckland seizure while the Compact holds; the Waikato and the Plateau are unheld ground where the domains' weight thins and Section 5's cameras multiply along State Highway One.
startingTimelineText:
AOTEAROA, THE NIGHT OF MARCH 21, 2026. One hundred and nineteen years since the Cross-Tasman Coordination Compact was sealed alongside the mortal Dominion arrangements, and the framework still holds: two small Kindred domains, two Garou septs, one compact, and the longest strategic shadow in the West — Five Eyes. Auckland holds the senior office: Princess Beatrice Hartley-Cowan, 178 years Embraced, 102 years on the throne she inherited when her senior met his true death in 1923, keeping an abbreviated court at the Parnell seat — Sir Geoffrey Whitmore counting the banks, Seneschal Whitmore-Ashby keeping the protocol, Sheriff Reedy walking the North Shore and the Waitākere edge, Hēmi Whatutua holding the Ngā Hau-e-Whā Primogen seat his community negotiated into being in 1971. Thirty-eight Kindred across five districts, from the CBD towers to Manukau's Pacific churches. Four hundred and eighty kilometres south, Wellington runs itself: Maggie Thornton's five-seat Coordination Council, seventeen Kindred, no prince and none wanted, the Beehive's ministers and the union halls and the diplomatic corps — a 1947 accommodation that Auckland registers and resents, and the 2027 Compact review is coming to decide whether it becomes something more. Between the cities: the Waikato, the Plateau, and the State Highway One corridor where the Section's cameras multiply. Eight things are about to test the framework.

1. THE 2027 REVIEW. The Compact's twelfth review must answer the Wellington question: does the Coordination Council formalise independently of Auckland supplemental authority? Hartley-Cowan supports formalisation on her terms; Thornton's Council supports it on different terms; Lytton backs continued Auckland-supplemental arrangement on precedent grounds. The negotiation work is now, and every district is a bargaining chip.

2. SECTION 5. Fourteen officers wired into Five Eyes, three true-deaths since 2020, and the July 2025 North Shore operation that read Auckland's financial and telephonic life like an open ledger. The August Discipline holds in Auckland, the October Discipline in Wellington, and Hartley-Cowan-Lytton surveillance correspondence runs weekly. 2026 pressure may exceed 2025 tempo.

3. THE PRINCESS'S QUESTION. Hartley-Cowan shows preliminary intermediate Beckoning signs — disclosed to exactly one Kindred, Lytton, and to nobody in Auckland. A 102-year throne with no announced succession sits beneath every Primogen faction, every sheriff's ambition, every whisper of the 2027 agenda. The information asymmetry is the politics.

4. WHATUTUA'S REVIEW. How the Compact recognises Māori-lineage Kindred at the 2027 review — the Ngā Hau-e-Whā seat, the iwi-relationship protocols, the cross-supernatural channels — is Hēmi Whatutua's institutional fight, conducted with the documented restraint the kit itself observes, and both cities need his position more than either will say.

5. THE PACIFIC COMING. Climate displacement from Tuvalu, Kiribati and Tokelau is producing diaspora arrival preparation across 2026-2030 — and the NZ Kindred communities' accommodation planning, Auckland-LA and Wellington-Sydney channels opening, is institutional work with real mortal stakes underneath it.

6. THE OCTOBER CHANNEL. The Brisbane chronicle-defining moment of October 2026 reaches NZ through five parallel routes — Hartley-Cowan-Lytton princely, Hauraki-Greene-Hawkins-Greene Glass Walker, Thornton-Footscray Anarch, Whatutua-Hawkins-Greene Māori-lineage, and Whitmore's Pacific Rim Ventrue axis. The framework was built for exactly this kind of night; it has never faced one.

7. THE BRISBANE LETTER. The Princess's most delicate channel — irregular correspondence with Bishop Callista Vox, Sabbat-survivor Brisbane — carries Pacific Rim remnant intelligence the Compact has no category for. Every exchange is worth a domain's weight in intelligence and a domain's weight in ruin.

8. THE WELLINGTON SEASON. Thornton's Labour-movement fabric is entering a documented mortal political year — parliamentary policy fights, union campaigns, the diplomatic corps in motion — and the Council's political-capital work is both the accommodation's best justification and the Section's richest surveillance target.

NOW: the country moves at night the way it always has — through the Parnell seat's monthly Primogen and the Council's rotating safehouses, the Sky Tower's feeding rotation and the Beehive's policy corridors, Ōtara's markets and Newtown's halls, the vineyards out west where the truce line runs along the bush edge, and the ranges where the septs watch the cities watch each other. The Compact holds the framework. The registration holds the Kindred. The disciplines hold the ledger. And at a Parnell window above the harbour, a woman who has outlived every negotiator but one reads Lytton's weekly letter and decides which truths Auckland can afford. Whoever keeps the Compact, the registration and the truce keeps Aotearoa. Whoever breaks one meets the framework — and the framework has eleven reviews of practice in deciding what to do with them.
